user.title: Set up Free Library Events
user.description: Choose one person and the Free Library of Philadelphia branches to follow. Events are matched locally using published ages and descriptions; the library feeds may be incomplete. Matching, refresh timing, and calendar subscriptions can be configured after setup.

data_description.child_name: Personalizes the digest. The name is stored in Home Assistant and is not sent to the library.
data_description.birth_date: Stored in Home Assistant to calculate age on each event date and select age-category feeds. The birth date itself is not sent to the library.
data_description.branches: Select at least one branch from the supported list. Only the selected branches are requested.

reconfigure.title: Update person and branches
reconfigure.description: Save to reload the integration with the updated profile and branch selection. Matching, refresh timing, and calendar-subscription settings are available in Configure.

data_description.branches: Select at least one branch from the supported list. Only the selected branches are requested.

init.title: Configure Free Library Events
init.description: Choose the settings to update. Calendar subscription: {webcal_status}. Anyone with a subscription URL can read the calendar; keep the URL private.

behavior.title: Matching and timing
behavior.description: These settings apply to the digest and calendars after the integration reloads. Age matching is a local interpretation of published information; check the official event details for suitability and requirements.

data_description.filter_mode: Strict includes the strongest age matches from published ranges, categories, and wording. Recommended also includes inclusive and possible matches. Broad adds general children's and family events.
data_description.calendar_duration_minutes: Used for calendar end times only when no end time was parsed from the feed. Default: 60 minutes. This is a placeholder, not a published duration.
data_description.scan_interval_seconds: Default: 21600 seconds (6 hours). Refresh events and the render action can request an earlier refresh. Calendar subscriptions read cached events; each calendar app controls its own polling.

webcal.title: Calendar subscription
webcal.description: Optionally expose the age-filtered event cache as an iCalendar feed. The URL contains an access token and works without a Home Assistant login. Anyone with either URL can read the feed. Current status: {webcal_status}

data_description.publish_webcal: Off by default. Saving with this disabled removes the token and stops access through the current URL. Events already copied by a calendar app may remain there.
data_description.webcal_name: Name included in the subscription feed. Calendar apps may let subscribers choose their own display name.

regenerate_webcal.title: Regenerate calendar subscription URL
regenerate_webcal.description: Continue to generate a replacement URL, then submit the next form to save it and invalidate the old URL. Existing subscribers will need the replacement URL to keep updating.

webcal_url.title: Calendar subscription URL
webcal_url.description:
{url_scope}. The calendar app must be able to reach this Home Assistant address. Copy a URL and select Submit to save these settings. Treat both URLs as passwords.

HTTP(S) subscription URL:
`{http_url}`

WebCal URL for apps that support it:
`{webcal_url}`

render_digest.name: Render weekly digest
render_digest.description: Return an age-matched weekly digest with email content and source-coverage metadata. This action does not send email or schedule delivery.

force_refresh.name: Refresh first
force_refresh.description: Wait for a completed feed refresh before rendering. If all source requests fail, the action fails. Turn off to use cached data, which may be stale. Partial results include coverage metadata.

embed_images.name: Embed event images
embed_images.description: Download supported event images and return temporary image paths plus SMTP attachments when Local Media is configured. Cleanup is scheduled after one hour; send the digest before then.

library_data_unavailable.message: No fetched event data is available. Use Refresh events, check the Status sensor, and run the action again after a successful refresh.

library_refresh_failed.message: The feed refresh failed, so no digest was returned. Check the Free Library Events Status sensor before trying again.

settings_changed_during_render.message: The integration was reloaded or its settings changed during the refresh, so no digest was returned. Run the action again with the current settings.

manual_refresh_failed.message: The requested refresh failed. Check the Free Library Events Status sensor for source errors and the last successful fetch.

library_source_update_failed.message: No source request succeeded in this refresh. Home Assistant will retry automatically; any earlier cached events may be stale.

single_loaded_entry_required.message: Load exactly one Free Library Events integration entry before running the digest action.
